state_audit.Default QMenuBar: Both background rules and both item text rules paired. Selected/pressed items add background-color:#d46986 to the existing combined rule, so they differ from the normal petal/active muted bar and retain dark readable text. No bitmap image declarations in the menubar family. No menu body changes.
state_audit.Default QToolTip: Opaque background and own text foreground are paired; rich-text embedded colors remain native/unverified.
state_audit.Default QScrollBar: Only enabled handle background; scrolling geometry, disabled handle and all arrows unchanged.
state_audit.SoundLibrary keyword field: Own base, !read-only:focus and :disabled rules exist. Change base/focus foreground and base opaque background. Its original :disabled rule restores native disabled BG/FG; no own read-only rule overrides it.
state_audit.Inspector caption timecode field: Own base, !read-only:focus and :disabled rules exist. Change base/focus foreground and base opaque background. Original disabled BG/FG retained. Own SkinSizeMode variants are geometry only.

palette_notes: New surfaces use only Cherry Blossom; existing TintGray text and OrcaGray icon backings are retained native exceptions.
